say:1:1330239301:1.text: Witnessing the demise of young lives pains me deeply.
say:1:1330239301:1.source_cn: 每次看到年轻的生命逝去，都让人惋惜。
say:1:1330239301:1.male: Witnessing the demise of young lives pains me deeply.
say:1:1330239301:1.female: Witnessing the demise of young lives pains me deeply.

say:2:1330239302:1.text: May Dura's blessing keep them safe and bring their souls together...
say:2:1330239302:1.source_cn: 但愿艾雅能庇佑他们，让他们的灵魂团聚……
say:2:1330239302:1.male: May Dura's blessing keep them safe and bring their souls together...
say:2:1330239302:1.female: May Dura's blessing keep them safe and bring their souls together...
